'''Cribblycrunch''' was an ingredient. Cribblycrunch topping was used in [[Kowakian crumb cake/Legends|Kowakian crumb cake]] which was served in [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].
